csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using UnityEngine.Rendering; using UnityEngine.Rendering.Universal; public class ForceURPSkybox { public static void Execute() { var urpAsset = GraphicsSettings.currentRenderPipeline as UniversalRenderPipelineAsset; if (urpAsset != null) { Debug.Log("Found URP Asset: " + urpAsset.name); } else { Debug.Log("Not using URP."); } foreach (var cam in Object.FindObjectsByType<Camera>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)) { cam.clearFlags = CameraClearFlags.Skybox; cam.backgroundColor = new Color(0.1f, 0.2f, 0.4f); var ucam = cam.GetComponent<UniversalAdditionalCameraData>(); if (ucam != null) { ucam.renderType = CameraRenderType.Base; } Debug.Log("Forced Skybox on Camera: " + cam.name); } Material skyMat = UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Material>("Assets/Materials/ProceduralSky.mat"); RenderSettings.skybox = skyMat; DynamicGI.UpdateEnvironment(); UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.SaveOpenScenes(); } }
